comments: Registered by the bale, not the burst: the pivot is the centre of the bale's base and its foot, and the rest bale alone sets the shared scale (0.084: 35 px wide, 22 tall).

The sprung frames reach above the 22 px canvas (the straw burst is up to 372 source px tall): their highest loose straw is cut by the canvas top. Reviewed: nothing is stretched, and the stage holds the first sprung frame.
geometry: The road, every collision box and every timing belong to the rules (rules/lightgallop); art never sets a hitbox or the terrain. The stage reads durations from assets/lightgallop/slots.json.
mapping_basis: Five drawings in a 3x2 grid (cell 6 empty): rest, then sprung-0..sprung-3. Reading order is the delivered one.

pieces.label: rest-0: delivered drawing 1 in reading order.
pieces.name: rest-0

pieces.label: sprung-0: delivered drawing 2 in reading order.
pieces.name: sprung-0

pieces.label: sprung-1: delivered drawing 3 in reading order.
pieces.name: sprung-1

pieces.label: sprung-2: delivered drawing 4 in reading order.
pieces.name: sprung-2

pieces.label: sprung-3: delivered drawing 5 in reading order.
pieces.name: sprung-3

size_basis: native canvas 36x22, anchor bottom-centre (18,22); stage 384x224; a round hay bale on its side.
timing: rest 1 ticks; sprung 4x3 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox.
